description: This PHP class defines a service for checking password strength policies within the OrangeHRM system, extending a base PasswordStrengthService and utilizing a TextHelperService for validation messages.

classes.name: InstallerPasswordStrengthService
classes.description: A service class that extends PasswordStrengthService to enforce password policies such as length, character types, and spaces, with configurable parameters.

methods.name: getTextHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of TextHelperService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Returns the minimum password length, defaulting to 8.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum password length, defaulting to 64.

methods.name: getMinNoOfLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of lowercase letters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of uppercase letters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfNumbers
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of numbers required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getMinNoOfSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of special characters required, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getIsSpacesAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether spaces are allowed in passwords, defaulting to 'false'.

methods.name: checkPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Checks a user's password against various policies and returns an array of violation messages.
